correctness.rationale: An independent geometric derivation takes L=range(Omega), S=diag(1,delta I) and (SL)^perp=S^(-1)L^perp. For X=||proj_(L^perp)e_1||^2, the unit projected direction has axial squared component X; its rescaling under S^(-1) stays orthogonal to S^(-1)(L^perp intersect e_1^perp). The squared component in the new complement is therefore X/[X+delta^(-2)(1-X)]. Haar L gives X~Beta((n-s)/2,s/2), hence the stated independent chi-square ratio. Trace splitting gives the exact rank-s baseline plus the weighted deficit, and Euler's beta integral gives the moment formula. With a=s/2, b=(n-s)/2, the odds N/D have density t^(a-1)(1+t)^(-a-b)/B(a,b). For q<a use integrability of t^(-q); for q>a substitute t=delta^2 v and obtain B(a,q-a). At q=a the scaled kernel is 1/v+O(v^(-2)) on [1,delta^(-2)] before damping; the damping changes the integral by O(1) there and the two outside pieces are O(1), proving the factor 2 in front of log(1/delta). The fixed-threshold tail integrates the odds density to delta^2(1-u)/u, giving the stated coefficient. Substitution at q=1 verifies all probe-count and leading residual claims. The full-rank QR identity makes p=2 the row-aware left space, not its right factor or final reconstruction. This does not assert uniformity as n,s,q vary. The uploaded checker was inspected, not executed; archived finite-check claims are not an independent certificate.
